children: German 10-year Bund yields offer value at 3.50%, Commerzbank's Rainer Guntermann says in a note. The 10-year Bund yield rose last week, hitting a new 15-year high of 3.519% on Friday as oil prices increased amid an escalating situation in the Middle East. However, the rates strategist adds that "the situation in the Middle East and the dynamics in energy prices still pose risks for outright yields and curves." The 10-year Bund yield closed at 3.503% on Friday, according to LSEG. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
